newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P says C-C Amatil on negative watch.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P says C-C Amatil on negative watch.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Thursday it had placed the AA-minus/A1-plus ratings of Coca-Cola Amatil Ltd and the AA-minus rating of subsidiary Coca-Cola Amatil (NZ) Ltd on negative credit watch.
S&P said the action follows similar action on C-C Amatil's major shareholder, The Coca-Cola Co.

"The rating action reflects the weakened creditor protection measures for the Coke system resulting from Coca-Cola Enterprises' recent announcement of its intention to acquire Coke Canada and The Coca-Cola Bottling Co of New York Inc for an aggregate purchase price of US$1.66 billion," S&P said.

"Standard and Poor's believes these acquisitions will likely be debt financed," it said. "However, it is unlikely that these ratings placed on credit watch for possible downgrade would be lowered more than one notch," the ratings agency said.
S&P said it would review the effects of the new acquisitions in conjuction with Coca-Cola Amatil's announced equity-financed acquisition of Coca-Cola Bottling Philippines Inc.
C-C Amatil shares were 15 cents lower at A$15.35 at 12.45 p.m. (0245 GMT).
